description: Elections Commission - Preparation of Electors Register - 2018
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically addresses voter registration procedures for internally displaced persons and their children under the Registration of Electors Act and its Special Provisions Act. It announces the timeline for accepting applications for a supplementary register of electors, provides details on eligibility criteria, and outlines the process for appeals - all of which fall under electoral processes and voter registration matters, making it a clear Type 7 (Elections) classification.
